lines.zh: 横着走，八只脚各踩各的沙。
lines.en: I walk sideways, eight feet each finding their own sand.

lines.zh: 沙粒在脚下响，像细小的鼓。
lines.en: Sand ticks under me like a tiny drum.

lines.zh: 岩石海岸的缝，只够我侧身过。
lines.en: The rock-shore crack barely fits me sideways.

lines.zh: 我一路挖，一路把沙拨到身后。
lines.en: I dig as I go, flicking sand behind me.

lines.zh: 退潮了，我要赶在日头前回洞。
lines.en: Tide is out; I must reach my hole before the sun.

lines.zh: 步子小，可我从不停下来。
lines.en: My steps are short, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 脚很轻，连贝壳都没惊动。
lines.en: My feet are light; not even shells were startled.

lines.zh: 我沿着浪线走，那里有碎屑。
lines.en: I follow the foam line, where scraps collect.

lines.zh: 绕过海葵，别踩它的触手。
lines.en: Around the anemone, or I will tread its tentacles.

lines.zh: 沙下的石头太滑，我换条路。
lines.en: The stone under the sand is slick; I take another path.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子，能钻进最窄的缝。
lines.en: Sideways, I can slip into the narrowest gap.

lines.zh: 潮池的水凉，正好润我的鳃。
lines.en: The tide pool is cool and rinses my gills.

lines.zh: 后面有影子，我加快八条腿。
lines.en: A shadow behind me; all eight legs speed up.

lines.zh: 走过湿沙，留下的印子很快消失。
lines.en: Prints in wet sand vanish soon after I pass.

lines.zh: 我从石头底下钻出来，抖掉沙。
lines.en: I slip out from under the stone and shake off sand.

lines.zh: 海星挡在路上，我跨过去。
lines.en: A starfish blocks the way; I step over it.

lines.zh: 浪推我一下，我顺势走三步。
lines.en: A wave shoves me, and I take three steps with it.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩缝挪，壳刮出细声。
lines.en: I edge along the rock seam, my shell scraping softly.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进沙，只露两只眼。
lines.en: I bury myself in sand and leave only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 洞口堆着新沙，是今天的活。
lines.en: Fresh sand at my burrow is today's work.

lines.zh: 我举着钳，听潮水退远。
lines.en: I raise a claw and listen to the tide withdraw.

lines.zh: 石缝里凉，我就在这儿歇。
lines.en: The rock crack is cool; I rest here.

lines.zh: 有只海龟在远处，我记住了。
lines.en: A turtle is out there; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 我用钳修洞口，修了又修。
lines.en: I trim my burrow mouth with a claw, then trim again.

lines.zh: 沙里有东西动，我停下听。
lines.en: Something stirs in the sand; I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 两只眼各看一边，都不放松。
lines.en: One eye watches each side, neither relaxing.

lines.zh: 我擦干净触须上的沙粒。
lines.en: I wipe the sand grains from my antennae.

lines.zh: 浪打过来，我贴住石头。
lines.en: A wave comes; I press flat against the stone.

lines.zh: 今天挖了三个洞，只用一个。
lines.en: I dug three holes today and use one.

lines.zh: 肚子贴着凉沙，很舒服。
lines.en: My belly against cool sand is a fine feeling.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水带回吃的。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to bring something to eat.

lines.zh: 壳上沾了盐，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Salt crusts my shell; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，沙都暗了。
lines.en: You stand too close; the sand has gone dark.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，两只眼分开看。
lines.en: I look up at you with two separate eyes.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩坏了我的洞口。
lines.en: Your boot crushed the mouth of my burrow.

lines.zh: 你是来抓我的，还是路过。
lines.en: Are you here to catch me, or just passing?

lines.zh: 我钳子小，可我不会白让。
lines.en: My claws are small, but I do not yield for free.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，影子还是很大。
lines.en: You crouch, and your shadow is still huge.

lines.zh: 我认得你的气味，是干的。
lines.en: I know your scent; it is dry.

lines.zh: 别用手罩我，我会夹。
lines.en: Do not cup your hand over me; I will pinch.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也在量你的指头。
lines.en: You watch me; I measure your fingers.

lines.zh: 退一步，我们都能看清对方。
lines.en: One step back, and we both see clearly.

lines.zh: 壳裂了，这疼要养很久。
lines.en: My shell is cracked; this pain will take time.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，我差点没命。
lines.en: You stepped on me and nearly ended me.

lines.zh: 三点的血，掉一点都心疼。
lines.en: Three points of health, and each one hurts.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳，可壳也不硬。
lines.en: I pull in, but my shell is not tough.

lines.zh: 钳子松了，我夹不住东西。
lines.en: My claw went slack; I cannot grip.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我整只翻了个面。
lines.en: One hit took me and flipped my whole shell over.

lines.zh: 沙进了伤口，火辣辣的。
lines.en: Sand got into the wound, and it burns.

lines.zh: 我往后爬，腿在抖。
lines.en: I crawl backward, legs trembling.

lines.zh: 够了，我的壳快散了。
lines.en: Enough; my shell is nearly coming apart.

lines.zh: 这个气味，我刻进壳里了。
lines.en: I have carved that smell into my shell.

lines.zh: 那是鱼肉吗，扔下来。
lines.en: Is that fish? Drop it down here.

lines.zh: 碎屑落在沙上，我先闻再动。
lines.en: Scraps on the sand; I sniff before I move.

lines.zh: 我不挑，海藻也吃。
lines.en: I am not picky; seaweed will do.

lines.zh: 你手一低，我钳就抬起来。
lines.en: Lower your hand and my claw comes up.

lines.zh: 这味道比腐叶强多了。
lines.en: This smells far better than rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 放远点，我怕你的手指。
lines.en: Set it farther off; I do not trust your fingers.

lines.zh: 我拿一半，剩下一半藏沙里。
lines.en: I take half and bury the rest in sand.

lines.zh: 潮水会带走味道，快点。
lines.en: The tide will wash the scent away; hurry.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我等它落稳。
lines.en: I do not lunge; I wait for it to settle.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，我才能挖一整夜。
lines.en: Fed, I can dig the whole night.

lines.zh: 你踢到我了，八只脚都乱了。
lines.en: You kicked me; all eight feet lost their rhythm.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻过来，快帮我。
lines.en: I have been flipped; help me up.

lines.zh: 壳撞石头，声音很脆。
lines.en: My shell struck stone with a brittle sound.

lines.zh: 别推，我的洞就在脚下。
lines.en: Do not push; my burrow is right underfoot.

lines.zh: 我夹住你的鞋尖，是本能。
lines.en: I grip your boot tip; it is instinct.

lines.zh: 一撞，我刚挖的沙全塌了。
lines.en: One bump and my fresh digging caved in.

lines.zh: 你踩的是我的退路。
lines.en: You are standing on my way out.

lines.zh: 我横着躲，还是慢了半拍。
lines.en: I dodged sideways, half a beat too slow.

lines.zh: 沙扬起来，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: Sand flies up; I can see nothing.

lines.zh: 轻点，我这壳只有三点血。
lines.en: Easy, this shell holds only three points.

lines.zh: 我举钳打招呼，她也举钳。
lines.en: I raise a claw; she raises hers back.

lines.zh: 我们并排挖一个洞。
lines.en: We dig one burrow side by side.

lines.zh: 她的壳比我的亮一点。
lines.en: Her shell is a shade brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 潮水来时，我们贴在一起。
lines.en: When the tide comes, we press together.

lines.zh: 我给她留了最大的那块碎肉。
lines.en: I saved her the largest scrap of flesh.

lines.zh: 两只蟹横着走，路更宽了。
lines.en: Two crabs walking sideways make the path wider.

lines.zh: 我们敲壳说话，一下一下。
lines.en: We speak by tapping shells, one tap at a time.

lines.zh: 洞口两个，其实通着。
lines.en: Two burrow mouths, and they connect underneath.

lines.zh: 她先回洞，我在外面守。
lines.en: She goes in first; I keep watch outside.

lines.zh: 沙地上两行印子并着走。
lines.en: Two lines of prints run side by side in the sand.

lines.zh: 别把我装进口袋，我会夹穿。
lines.en: Do not pocket me; I will pinch through.

lines.zh: 你手心太热，我受不了。
lines.en: Your palm is too warm for me.

lines.zh: 提着我的壳，别碰钳子。
lines.en: Hold me by the shell, away from the claws.

lines.zh: 我腿在空中乱划，放我下去。
lines.en: My legs paddle air; put me down.

lines.zh: 你手里有海水味，还行。
lines.en: Your hand smells of seawater; that is acceptable.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，你拿不稳的。
lines.en: I pull into my shell; you will not hold me steady.

lines.zh: 三点的血，经不起你捏。
lines.en: Three points of health will not survive your squeeze.

lines.zh: 我钳子夹住你袖口了，抱歉。
lines.en: My claw caught your sleeve; apologies.

lines.zh: 到水边就放我，我自己走。
lines.en: Set me by the water and I will walk myself.

lines.zh: 你走一路，我晃一路。
lines.en: You walk the whole way; I sway the whole way.

lines.zh: 海龟的鳍在动，我看见了。
lines.en: A turtle's flipper moves; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 那壳太大，可我要试。
lines.en: That shell is too big, but I will try.

lines.zh: 它爬得慢，我追得上。
lines.en: It crawls slowly; I can catch it.

lines.zh: 沙里有小东西，先记下。
lines.en: Something small is in the sand; noted.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，钳口张开。
lines.en: I lower my body and open my claws.

lines.zh: 目标选小的，大的留给别人。
lines.en: I pick the small target and leave the big one.

lines.zh: 它的脚印还新，就在前面。
lines.en: Its prints are fresh and just ahead.

lines.zh: 我等它自己蹭到礁石边上。
lines.en: I wait until it wanders close to the rockside.

lines.zh: 眼睛锁住了，八条腿就绪。
lines.en: My eyes have locked on; eight legs are ready.

lines.zh: 这一下要准，我只有一次。
lines.en: This must be precise; I get one try.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙前进，钳不出声。
lines.en: I creep along the sand, claws silent.

lines.zh: 它转头了，我立刻停住。
lines.en: It turned; I freeze at once.

lines.zh: 再近一步，就能夹到鳍。
lines.en: One step closer and the flipper is in reach.

lines.zh: 浪声盖住我的脚步。
lines.en: The surf covers the sound of my steps.

lines.zh: 我从侧面上，正面太硬。
lines.en: I come from the side; the front is too hard.

lines.zh: 它的影子罩住我，正好。
lines.en: Its shadow covers me; perfect.

lines.zh: 我数着它的呼吸，等空档。
lines.en: I count its breaths and wait for a gap.

lines.zh: 钳举起来，别抖。
lines.en: Raise the claw and do not tremble.

lines.zh: 它离石头还有两步。
lines.en: It is two steps from the rock.

lines.zh: 时机到了，八条腿一起动。
lines.en: The moment is here; all eight legs push at once.

lines.zh: 夹住了，别想甩开。
lines.en: Pinched, and you will not shake me loose.

lines.zh: 我钳住它的鳍根。
lines.en: I clamp the base of its flipper.

lines.zh: 这一夹，用尽我全身的力。
lines.en: This pinch takes all the strength I have.

lines.zh: 壳对壳，我不吃亏。
lines.en: Shell against shell, I do not come off worse.

lines.zh: 它挣扎，我夹得更紧。
lines.en: It struggles; I hold tighter.

lines.zh: 我的钳尖戳进缝里。
lines.en: My claw tip jabs into the gap.

lines.zh: 打一下就跑，这是我学的。
lines.en: Hit once and run; that is what I learned.

lines.zh: 三点伤害，也够它记住。
lines.en: Three points of damage is enough to be remembered.

lines.zh: 沙被我们搅得看不清。
lines.en: Our tussle stirs the sand blind.

lines.zh: 松开，退两步，再举钳。
lines.en: Release, back two steps, raise the claw again.

lines.zh: 岩石海岸，我出生在石缝里。
lines.en: Rocky shore: I was born in a rock crack.

lines.zh: 这一带只有我和另一只。
lines.en: Only I and one other live in this stretch.

lines.zh: 浪把壳推上岸，我爬了出来。
lines.en: The surf pushed a shell ashore; I climbed out.

lines.zh: 潮池浅，正好当我的第一个家。
lines.en: The shallow tide pool suits as my first home.

lines.zh: 石头多的地方，我们才住得下。
lines.en: We can only live where stones are many.

lines.zh: 盐味进了壳，我就知道到家了。
lines.en: Salt soaks my shell, and I know I am home.

lines.zh: 我挖开沙，底下是湿的。
lines.en: I dig, and the sand beneath is wet.

lines.zh: 同伴在旁边，我们各挖各的。
lines.en: A companion is near; we dig separately.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是找块能藏的石头。
lines.en: First thing: find a stone to hide under.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我往阴处挪。
lines.en: Day breaks; I shift into the shade.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，我要回水里。
lines.en: My shell bakes hot; I need the water.

lines.zh: 从石头上摔下来，壳磕掉一角。
lines.en: I fell from the rock and chipped my shell.

lines.zh: 水太深，我的腿够不到底。
lines.en: Too deep here; my legs cannot reach bottom.

lines.zh: 沙全被掀起来，我埋在里面。
lines.en: The sand exploded upward and buried me.

lines.zh: 什么东西扎进壳缝，拔不出来。
lines.en: Something stuck in my shell seam and will not come out.

lines.zh: 那道光让我壳发麻。
lines.en: That light numbed my whole shell.

lines.zh: 三天没吃到碎屑，腿发软。
lines.en: Three days without scraps and my legs weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打在岸上，我沙里发抖。
lines.en: Lightning struck the shore; I shake in the sand.

lines.zh: 底下没有沙，只有空。
lines.en: There is no sand below, only emptiness.
